decisive_items: intermittent fevers, episodic night sweats, decreased appetite, and palpitations
sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells
response.rationale: Systemic symptoms and granulomatous inflammation suggest sarcoidosis over lymphoma due to the combination of clinical presentation and biopsy findings.

rejected.why: Lack of response to antibiotics and absence of typical pyomyositis features
